subject: Re: AxiomAI billing - temporary credit request for streaming gap
messages:
From: Ellis Moore <ellis@axiomai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@axiomai.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing request: temporary credit for streaming gap

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note on behalf of AxiomAI — we hit a feature gap in the streaming API you announced last quarter. Our integration depends on continuous prefix caching and there was an incompatibility with your newest runtime that caused elevated token counts for three production jobs between Oct 18-22. We opened a support ticket (SUP-1148) and the team confirmed a runtime patch is queued, but the additional token usage bumped our bill unexpectedly.

Can Redwood provide a bridging credit for the overage while the patch is in flight? The October usage report is attached to show the delta. We value Redwood and want to keep the deployment on track, but the unexpected cost is a blocker for our procurement sign-off on expanding Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: AX-usage-report-Oct.csv (CSV, 84KB)

Thanks,
Ellis Moore
Head of Integrations | AxiomAI
ellis@axiomai.com
procurement@axiomai.com

--
Forwarded message details available upon request.

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Billing request: temporary credit for streaming gap

Team — forwarding Ellis' note from AxiomAI. They hit a usage spike tied to a feature gap (prefix/KV caching mismatch) and are asking for a temporary bridging credit for the Oct overage. This is starting to block their procurement team from committing to Dedicated.

Asks:
- Product (Karthik) — can you confirm ETA for the patch and whether this scenario is covered by our fallback policies? Any workaround we can recommend?
- Finance/Commercial (Dylan, Laura) — what's the max short-term credit we can offer without exec approval? If we need an exception, I'll escalate to Evelyn.

I'll draft proposed language (credit amount + timebox) once I have ETA. Attached Ellis' usage CSV.

Attachments: AX-usage-report-Oct.csv

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing request: temporary credit for streaming gap

Vanessa — reviewed the usage and logs. Short answer: the issue is real and results from a regression in the cache key normalization path introduced in runtime v3.8.1. The fix is in CI and we plan to promote the patch to staging this week; ETA for production rollout is 2026-11-12 assuming no blockers.

Workarounds we can advise today:
- Pin customers to runtime v3.7.x (no behavior change for most models) — requires a restart and will affect autoscaling behavior briefly.
- Enable explicit prefix caching via the API header (we can provide the exact header).

Impact assessment: AxiomAI saw a token delta of ~42% on three pipelines during the affected window — matches their report. If they can pin to 3.7 or apply header, the cost delta disappears.

I'll attach brief roadmap notes and the PR link for transparency. If Finance needs an answer now for a credit size, recommend a temporary capped credit equivalent to 30% of the overage, refundable if they apply the workaround or we confirm patch resolves the issue after rollout.

Attachments: roadmap-notes.pdf; PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4982

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: AxiomAI credit request (RDW-7521)

Thanks for the context. I agree this looks like a product regression and want to move quickly to avoid losing a Dedicated deal. Conditional approval from leadership:

- Approve a one-time credit up to $18,000 (cap) to cover the October overage, conditional on AxiomAI signing a short mutual action addendum that commits to one of the following within 30 days: pin to v3.7, enable the prefix header, or accept the patched runtime once deployed.
- The credit will be issued as usage credit (applied to the next invoice) and will be revoked if we find evidence of deliberate misconfiguration on their side.
- Finance to generate the credit memo and legal to review the addendum. Vanessa, please coordinate DocuSign and procurement contact.

Requested artifacts for compliance: AxiomAI's Oct usage CSV (attached), the support ticket SUP-1148 transcript, and a signed addendum. I'll sign off once legal okays the language.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

--
Approval note: leadership cap validated against reserve credit policy #RC-2.

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Ellis Moore <ellis@axiomai.com>, procurement@axiomai.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Billing request: temporary credit for streaming gap

Ellis — thanks for your patience. We've reviewed the usage and product has confirmed a patch ETA of Nov 12. Leadership has approved a one-time bridging credit up to $18,000, contingent on a short addendum that confirms AxiomAI will apply one of the mitigations (pin to v3.7, enable prefix header, or accept patched runtime) within 30 days.

Next steps:
1) I'll send a one-page addendum (DocuSign) today to procurement@axiomai.com.
2) Finance (Laura & Dylan) will prepare a credit memo; once the addendum is signed we'll apply the credit to the next invoice.
3) Karthik's team will share the header and pin instructions; they'll also confirm the patch post-rollout.

If that works for you, expect DocuSign from me in the next few hours. Appreciate the partnership — we're committed to getting you back to expected economics quickly.

Attachments referenced: AX-usage-report-Oct.csv; roadmap-notes.pdf

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
